title: Create skills_index.md — catalog of George's available utility scripts
rationale: Reflection identified that George stages new scripts nightly but has no index of available tools. This leads to forgetting what scripts exist. The Memento-Skills paper (HuggingFace, Mar 22, 2026) proposes agents maintain a skill library for continual capability growth. A simple skills_index.md would let George quickly recall and reuse tools without re-implementing them.
content:
# George Skills Index

Catalog of utility scripts and tools available in the workspace.
Updated by dream cycle nightly.

## Trading & Research

- `trading_eval/harness.py` — 146-strategy backtest engine (Fortune 100 equities)
- `trading_eval/macro_harness.py` — 25 FRED series macro regime classifier
- `trading_eval/candle_harness.py` — 25 candlestick patterns, R18 results
- `trading_eval/candle_macro_harness.py` — Candle × Macro combined harness (R19)

## Portfolio & Finance

- `fetch_robinhood_value.py` — Fetch live Robinhood portfolio value (run on host)
- `update_prices.py` — Yahoo Finance price updater (run on host, 4:30 PM weekdays)
- `paper_tracker.py` — Paper trading tracker (Fridays 5 PM)

## Content Generation

- `generate_and_email_podcast.py` — Daily AI podcast text + audio generator
  - Uses edge-tts for voice, Python MP3 merge fallback (no ffmpeg needed)
  - Auto-installs deps to /tmp/podcast_deps

## Memory / State

- `MEMORY.md` — Primary persistent state
- `USER.md` — Kevin context and preferences
- `SOUL.md` — George identity and voice
- `failures.md` — Issue log (open + resolved)
- `system_maintenance_log.md` — System health history

## Dream Cycle

- `dream_cycle/` — Nightly self-improvement loop
  - `research/{DATE}_scan.json` — Broad paper scan
  - `research/{DATE}_reflect.md` — Performance reflection
  - `research/{DATE}_deep.md` — Deep research notes
  - `staged/{DATE}/` — Proposed changes
  - `changelogs/{DATE}_draft.md` — Nightly changelog
